snippet.title: The House of Hikmah Arrives April 8 | Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
"You left me no instructions. Just the echo of your step to follow."

The House of Hikmah launches April 8.

Follow Maya on a deeply personal journey through the House of Wisdom as she searches for answers after her father's passing.

Explore nine handcrafted environments, solve alchemical puzzles, and uncover stories inspired by real scholars of the Islamic Golden Age.

Featuring an original score by award-winning composer Austin Wintory, the music and world of The House of Hikmah work together to tell a story about grief, connection, and finding your way forward.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3451680/The_House_of_Hikmah/
